proposed_from.topic: Sharp target fibers and honest inference through covariance-profile collisions. In a fixed-dimensional acyclic linear Gaussian SCM with stationary latent confounding and positive measurement error, exactly r unknown observed structural-noise coordinates change variance across environments, one reference changes all r, and every shift range lies in the reference range. Prove that a labeled size-r target set is compatible exactly when some ordering makes its reference principal block positive definite and the resulting unit-lower LDL factor simultaneously diagonalizes every target-block shift with nonnegative diagonals. Construct a legal positive-noise SCM for every certificate and any positive-definite baseline; compute the complete target family, compulsory and possible nodes by subset-memoized pivot recursion; and develop augmented covariance confidence regions with honest family coverage and a sharp information-distance boundary for classification near profile collisions. Apply the certificates cautiously to uncertain effective targets in multi-environment Perturb-seq/Sci-Plex analysis. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Full-shift reconstruction from target blocks and range inclusion, unit-lower DAG completion, and arbitrary-baseline realization with strictly positive structural and measurement noises were derived. Subset-memoized pivot certificates matched exhaustive LDL enumeration on 55 exact rational instances; all 12 orderings in the four-node witness were rechecked. A collision path has classification distance proportional to its profile split. Fixed-level model-region emptiness and outer-family versus classification coverage were attacked and resolved by feasible-point augmentation and complete-classification projection; close heteroskedastic-SVAR work did not supply this target-fiber theorem. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove a measurable certified approximate-selection lemma on the nonclosed exact-rank covariance model, returning a feasible tuple arbitrarily close to the weighted infimum without assuming an attained projection. EARLY KILL TEST: In the d=4,r=2 witness, independently make feasible-point augmentation retain uniform coverage, guaranteed nonemptiness, measurability, and shrinking information diameter when the raw covariance region misses the exact-rank model; failure stops the formulation. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest theorem-level results separate into three nonoverlapping objects.  Yang, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash give a graphical candidate superset under latent confounding, not the complete covariance-compatible family.  BACKSHIFT and coroICA identify a global mixing matrix when source variance profiles separate; they inform the covariance-difference construction but do not supply the two novel panel-design restrictions or every acyclic observed-node labeling at collisions.  In Bacchiocchi et al. arXiv v1, Theorems 1--3 concern sign/permutation equivalence, distinct-eigenvalue point identification, and eigen-decomposition.  Their later Section III multiplicity analysis defines restricted rotation sets for HSVAR structural parameters and impulse responses, not a discrete acyclic labeled-target fiber.  The new kernel is the equality between the causal target fiber and the ordered principal-block \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) fiber under the stated panel design.  Its constructive converse is essential: without it, the certificate could be only necessary algebra.  The explicit relaxation witnesses delimit the kernel without hiding failure behind stronger assumptions.  The subset recursion and honest collision-aware classification are consequences of that exact fiber, while generic joint diagonalization, identified-set inversion, measurable selection, and weak-identification arguments are credited as adapted techniques rather than claimed advances.

seed_details.title: Exact labeled target fiber from ordered principal-block certificates
seed_details.anchor_locations: Yang et al., Introduction, Theorem 2, Appendix D.6, and Conclusion; BACKSHIFT, Introduction, Theorem 1, Appendix A, and Conclusion.
seed_details.kernel: Prove that the causal family of labeled size-\(r\) targets equals the union over orderings of the positive principal-block simultaneous \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) certificates.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace uniqueness of the global joint diagonalizer by inversion of coordinate restriction on \(\operatorname{range}(Q)\), followed by unit-lower completion in a candidate target order.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining unknown targets, covariance differences, stationary measurement error, latent confounding, and simultaneous \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) found target supersets, global diagonalizers, and HSVAR rotation sets but no labeled-fiber theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from BACKSHIFT because covariance differences already have a common diagonalizer.
seed_details.rebuttal: BACKSHIFT identifies an unlabeled global mixing matrix only under pairwise profile separation; it neither imposes acyclic observed-node labels nor enumerates every legal label set when profiles collide.

seed_details.title: Arbitrary-baseline positive-noise realization
seed_details.anchor_locations: Yang et al., Introduction, Theorem 1, Appendix C.1, and Conclusion; BACKSHIFT, covariance-difference construction and Appendix A.
seed_details.kernel: Show that every algebraic certificate and every positive-definite baseline admit an acyclic Gaussian SCM realization with strictly positive structural and stationary measurement noises.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After reconstructing changed columns, spend a quantified eigenvalue slack \(\tau\) and represent the positive remainder through unrestricted stationary latent roots.
seed_details.destination_search: Measurement-error papers start from separability, while covariance-shift papers do not establish a converse that preserves both structural-noise and measurement-noise positivity at an arbitrary baseline.
seed_details.red_team: A covariance factorization is already an SCM realization by Cholesky decomposition.
seed_details.rebuttal: A generic Cholesky factor does not preserve unit diagonal total effects, the proposed target labels, acyclicity, stationary nuisance, or strict positivity of both primitive noise layers.

seed_details.title: Profile quotient with acyclic label selectors
seed_details.anchor_locations: coroICA, Introduction, identifiability theorem, Appendix A, and Conclusion; Bacchiocchi et al., Introduction, Definition 4, Theorems 1--3, and Conclusion.
seed_details.kernel: Identify joint eigenspaces indexed by distinct variance profiles and characterize which coordinate flags inside repeated-profile quotient blocks admit a unit-lower acyclic labeling.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the repeated-profile eigenspaces instead of selecting eigenvectors, then intersect their internal rotations with coordinate-restriction and triangularity constraints.
seed_details.destination_search: HSVAR work occupies repeated-eigenvalue rotation sets, but searches found no passage from those quotient blocks to a complete family of observed intervention labels.
seed_details.red_team: This is merely the standard repeated-eigenvalue rotation indeterminacy.
seed_details.rebuttal: The quotient itself is standard; the potentially new content is the discrete acyclic coordinate-label selector, which is fully captured more directly by S1.

seed_details.title: Subset-memoized complete pivot enumeration
seed_details.anchor_locations: Yang et al., Theorem 2 and Appendix D.6; Squires et al., Introduction, interventional equivalence characterization, consistency theorem, and permutation-search construction.
seed_details.kernel: Prove soundness, completeness, termination, and a \(\sum_{k=0}^{r}\binom{d}{k}\) visited-state bound for a full-column proportionality recursion memoized by selected subsets.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace permutation scoring by hereditary Schur residuals that are provably independent of the accepted order leading to a subset.
seed_details.destination_search: Unknown-target algorithms search permutations or graph-target classes; simultaneous-congruence algorithms decide a common transform but do not recover acyclic labeled subsets.
seed_details.red_team: Finite enumeration of all target sets and orderings already gives completeness.
seed_details.rebuttal: The subset identity removes repeated prefix histories, supplies an exact pivot oracle, and proves compulsory and possible labels without enumerating DAGs, although the worst case remains exponential.

seed_details.title: Measurable certified approximate projection
seed_details.anchor_locations: Romano--Shaikh, Introduction, Theorem 2.3, Section 2.3, and proof of uniform coverage; Brown--Purves, the two measurable-extrema theorems and the nonexistence warning for Borel exact minimizers.
seed_details.kernel: Produce a semialgebraic and Borel \(\epsilon\)-optimal feasible selector, with a certificate witness, even though exact rank and strict pivots make the model nonclosed.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace an attained argmin correspondence by the strict semialgebraic sublevel graph \(G_{\epsilon}\) and apply definable choice before invoking Borel measurability.
seed_details.destination_search: Identified-set inference assumes criterion inversion, while measurable-extrema results distinguish Borel and universal selectors; no source located the exact-rank certified covariance selector used here.
seed_details.red_team: Choose a countable dense sequence and take the first approximately minimizing point.
seed_details.rebuttal: That proves bare measurability only after constructing a dense feasible sequence; the proposed lemma also returns an exact semialgebraic rank and ordering certificate for every real-valued sample input.

seed_details.title: Always-nonempty honest target-family confidence regions
seed_details.anchor_locations: Strieder et al., Introduction, Theorem 1, split-likelihood construction, and Conclusion; Romano--Shaikh, Introduction, Theorem 2.3, and Section 2.3.
seed_details.kernel: Augment a finite-sample covariance region by the certified approximate selector and project the entire compatible target fiber and complete classification through the augmented model intersection.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Do not condition on a selected target set and do not assume the raw region intersects the nonclosed model; add one measurable feasible point before projection.
seed_details.destination_search: Causal test inversion retains graph uncertainty, and identified-set inversion covers images, but neither handles guaranteed nonemptiness for this exact-rank discrete family.
seed_details.red_team: Coverage is immediate by projecting any covariance confidence ball.
seed_details.rebuttal: A raw ball can miss the nonclosed model and produce an empty output, while projecting only the union of targets can conceal a wrong compulsory classification; both defects require the augmented complete-classification construction.

seed_details.title: Information-distance boundary for discrete target classification
seed_details.anchor_locations: Lewis, Introduction, Theorems 1--3, proof of Theorem 1, and Conclusion; Bacchiocchi et al., Introduction, Theorems 1--3, bivariate discriminant theorem, and Conclusion.
seed_details.kernel: Show that divergence of Gaussian covariance-information distance to a different compulsory-and-possible classification is sufficient for honest certification, while bounded distance precludes consistent certification.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace rank-test asymptotics for a continuous parameter by likelihood-ratio moment control between opposite finite semialgebraic classification strata.
seed_details.destination_search: Weak-HSVAR papers analyze near-proportional variance changes and repeated eigenvalues but do not classify complete observed-node target fibers or derive their information-distance boundary.
seed_details.red_team: This is a generic Le Cam two-point argument with a renamed distance.
seed_details.rebuttal: The statistical principle is generic, so novelty rests on the exact opposite-stratum geometry, legal two-SCM path, and complete-family upper procedure supplied by S1 and S6.

seed_details.title: Closure of the positive-noise target fiber
seed_details.anchor_locations: BACKSHIFT, Introduction, covariance-difference model, necessity part of Appendix A, and Conclusion.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize which singular \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\) boundary certificates are limits of legal strictly positive-noise SCMs as pivots or reference shifts vanish.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the interior eigenvalue-slack completion by a tangent-cone characterization of simultaneous positivity for the baseline decomposition.
seed_details.destination_search: Simultaneous-congruence papers characterize algebraic feasibility, while the covariance-shift literature does not separate algebraic boundary certificates from limits of positive-noise causal models.
seed_details.red_team: Closure follows by adding \(\epsilon I_d\) to every noise covariance.
seed_details.rebuttal: Such perturbation can alter exact rank, common range, target support, and zero-pivot structure, so causal approximability is not automatic.
seed_details.disposition: dropped in favor of the interior sharp fiber

seed_details.title: Effective-target correspondence for perturbational transcriptomics
seed_details.anchor_locations: Dixit et al., introduction, guide-reassignment construction, results on incomplete efficacy, and discussion; Srivatsan et al., introduction, dose-response analysis, and discussion; Squires et al., genomics motivation and unknown-target setup.
seed_details.kernel: Give design-level conditions under which pseudobulk covariance differences satisfy the stationary exact-rank shift model, with an outer family when uptake mixtures or state selection violate exact correspondence.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Insert a cell-aggregation and label-error layer before the Gaussian SCM and prove that it preserves the common-range factorization.
seed_details.destination_search: Perturb-seq and Sci-Plex document incomplete or heterogeneous responses, while unknown-target causal algorithms warn against nominal labels; no exact data-to-covariance-SCM correspondence was found.
seed_details.red_team: The application merely assumes away count noise and heterogeneous uptake.
seed_details.rebuttal: A credible theorem must derive preservation or enlarge the family under explicit violations; that layer remains too empirical for the present exact-identification kernel.
